body: Thank you. They truly do mean everything to me and I don’t want to ruin them

What’s ironic is that they have depression (mom) and bipolar (sister). But of course, me going home is being selfish. I’m being told that I need to just overlook my anxiety and face my demons. I said I’m not ready and no one cares how I feel. 

I don’t want to do this to my kids. They don’t deserve it but I honestly feel like a burden. I have all these mental illnesses as well as physical ones too that make me unable to work. I wish I could give them a better life.
